observational_status: matched eight-case normalized-native M3D-C1 fieldwise jphi source-response diagnostic; no imported shot, calibrated physical current integral, validated equilibrium/profile handoff, or segmented electrode controller-in-loop
successful_milestone: Eight normalized-native M3D-C1 source-response runs completed (249.10 s) with exact same-mode zero-source field equivalence (0 <= 1e-12), matched 1004-element mesh and three comparison times. Opposite-sign response fields remain observable; full-field timestep differences are now quantified rather than inferred from aggregate cancellation.
interpretation: Result 134 weakens quantitative numerical convergence: at t=0.01 the positive-command coarse-to-fine weighted L2 field difference is 154.0% of the fine-field norm (weighted cosine 0.284). At t=0.03 the negative-command field difference is 52.9% (cosine 0.917), while positive is 21.9% (cosine 0.976). Odd-symmetry residual improves from 35.94% to 3.11% at t=0.03 but does not rescue fieldwise convergence. These are normalized-native mesh-weighted diagnostics, not calibrated current conservation.
followup_scope: One focused 12-run three-level dt=0.0025/0.00125/0.000625 fieldwise jphi sensitivity test at t=0.01/0.02/0.03, preserving solver, mesh, source mode, commands and zero equivalence. Empirical difference ratios are diagnostics, not automatic convergence proof.
handoff_equivalence: unvalidated; same-mode zero-source equivalence is not experimental equilibrium/profile handoff
pb11_fidelity_limits: not_applicable; no p-B11 reaction, recirculation, radiation/electron-loss, alpha transport/channeling, boron delivery, direct conversion, rotating plasma, rotation/shear, liquid lithium, ignition margin or net-power evidence
m3dc1_claim_boundary: Fieldwise temporal sensitivity of normalized-native M3D-C1 jphi actuator response only. e[2] is an uncalibrated mesh weight. Two dt levels do not establish numerical convergence. No physical current conservation, segmented-electrode authority, experimental shot handoff, causal TCT stabilization, p-B11 fidelity or reactor-net-power claim.
